info.name: Home4You API
info.description:
API collection for Home4You - a real estate property listing platform.

## Authentication
- **Bearer Token**: Protected endpoints require `Authorization: Bearer <token>` header
- **HMAC Signing**: All non-system endpoints require HMAC signature headers:
  - `x-signature`: HMAC-SHA256 signature of the payload
  - `x-timestamp`: Unix timestamp of the request
  - `x-nonce`: Unique nonce for replay protection

## Base URL
All endpoints are prefixed with `/api/v1`

## Rate Limiting
- Public endpoints: Lower rate limits
- Authenticated endpoints: Higher rate limits

request.description:
Create a new property listing.

**Required fields:**
- `price`: Positive number
- `propertyType`: Type of property (apartment, house, condo, etc.)
- `transactionType`: sale or rent
- `locationReadable`: Human-readable address
- `locationCoordinates`: GeoJSON Point with [longitude, latitude]
- `isAvailable`: Boolean availability status
Get details of a specific property by its ID.

Search and filter properties with pagination.

**Query Parameters:**
- `page`: Page number (default: 1)
- `limit`: Items per page (1-100, default: 10)
- `minPrice`: Minimum price filter
- `maxPrice`: Maximum price filter
- `category`: Property category
- `transactionType`: sale or rent
- `city`: City filter
- `country`: Country filter
- `bedrooms`: Number of bedrooms
- `sortBy`: price, createdAt, or areaSqFt
- `sortOrder`: asc or desc

item.description:
Property management endpoints for creating and searching real estate properties.

All endpoints require authentication (Bearer token) and HMAC signing headers.
